example:
• 2019

    Founded

    Two designers start the studio.

usage.useWhen: One entry inside a timeline: with a date (datetime YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD and the date as shown in a time element), or without date with a free label such as "First journey" in a span: leave date empty and write the label as text of the __date element.
usage.avoidWhen: Outside a timeline; it only works as its child.
usage.a11y: Set the heading level so it fits the heading outline of the page. A label without date is plain text, never a time element.
